lesson.subject: general-knowledge
lesson.title: General Knowledge Check-In: Where Am I?
lesson.summary: A friendly tour of our planet, time, people who help us, healthy habits and amazing animals, so we can see what you already know.
learning_objectives: Show what I know about Earth and where I live
Show what I know about days, weeks and months
Show what I know about helpers, healthy habits and animals

blocks.markdown:
Let's explore the world and everything in it!

This is a **check-in**, not a test.

Tell a grown-up what you already know.

We live on planet **Earth**. Most of Earth is covered by water in big **oceans**.

The land is split into seven big areas called **continents**. Pakistan is in the continent of Asia.

The Sun is a star that gives us light and heat.

blocks.alt: Planet Earth has 7 continents and 5 oceans.
blocks.caption: Planet Earth has 7 continents and 5 oceans.

question.prompt: What do we call the big areas of land on Earth?

blocks.alt: The Sun gives us light and heat in the day.
blocks.caption: The Sun gives us light and heat in the day.

blocks.markdown:
There are **7 days** in a week and **12 months** in a year.

The days are Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday. A day has **24 hours**.

blocks.title: Why we have day and night

scenes.caption: The Earth spins round and round.
The side facing the Sun has day.
The side turned away has night.

question.prompt: How many days are in a week?

blocks.title: My week
instructions: Draw seven boxes, one for each day.
Write or draw one thing you do on each day.

blocks.markdown:
**Doctors** and **nurses** keep us healthy. **Teachers** help us learn. **Firefighters** put out fires. **Farmers** grow our food.

Every job helps the community.

blocks.alt: Firefighters, doctors and nurses, teachers and farmers all help us.
blocks.caption: Firefighters, doctors and nurses, teachers and farmers all help us.

question.prompt: Who helps us when we are ill?

blocks.markdown:
To stay healthy we eat fruit and vegetables and drink water.

We sleep well and wash our hands. Sweets and fizzy drinks are only for treats.

blocks.alt: Fruit, vegetables, milk and water help our bodies stay healthy.
blocks.caption: Fruit, vegetables, milk and water help our bodies stay healthy.

question.prompt: Which of these is the healthiest snack?

blocks.markdown:
The **blue whale** is the biggest animal in the world. The **cheetah** is the fastest land animal.

Camels can live in hot deserts. Polar bears live in the cold Arctic.

blocks.alt: A whale in the sea, a cheetah on the grass, a camel in the desert and a polar bear in the snow.
blocks.caption: A whale in the sea, a cheetah on the grass, a camel in the desert and a polar bear in the snow.

blocks.prompt: Which animal would you like to meet, and why?
blocks.answer_markdown: There is no wrong answer. Tell a grown-up what makes that animal special.

blocks.title: Match the explorers
blocks.goal: Turn over two cards and find the pairs.

points: We live on Earth, which has oceans and continents.
A week has 7 days and a year has 12 months.
Many people help us in our community.
Healthy food, sleep and clean hands keep us well.
Animals live in many different places.

blocks.markdown: When you are ready, start the quiz. It has 15 questions and takes about 15 minutes. Do your best!
